provenance: REAL (Satellite Observation, NASA GPM IMERG V07)
methodological_note: Precipitation data derived from the official NASA GPM IMERG V07 half-hourly product (NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V07). Half-hourly precipitation rates (mm/hr) were integrated (multiplied by 0.5) and spatially averaged over the Cachar study window [92.70, 24.75, 92.90, 24.90]. Because spatial variation across this 20 km x 16 km window is minimal, rainfall is provided as basin-wide meteorological context rather than input to a spatial regression model.
